Solution (Story): - Front Row: Robe, Urn, Chopsticks - Back Row: Rat, Fish Solution (Hard): - Front Row: Chopsticks, Urn, Rat - Back Row: Fish, Robe Solution (Lost in the Fog): - Front Row: Chopsticks, Robe, Urn - Back Row: Fish, Rat Solve it to open a [Locked Door](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-f/maps/ebisugaoka?locationIds=482638).

title: Scarecrow Puzzle
description: _Tip: When the scarecrows point, run directly in that direction to continue the puzzle._ Solution (Story): Pull the nail out of: - The girl carrying a knife. - The girl who isn't visibly armed. - The girl with a yellow bird brooch. - The girl staring at a boy. She's being looked at by another girl with her arms behind her back. - The girl with a similar haircut to yours, staring at the ground at the back of the group. Solution (Hard): Pull the nail out of: - The only smiling girl - The girl with knives in her back and hand. - The girl looking at a boy with his back turned. - The girl forcing her head back over her shoulder. - The girl with her head down, smiling. Solution (Lost in the Fog): Pull the nail out of: - The girl whose head is upside-down. - The girl with a knife at her feet. - The girl with no knife, facing away from the boy on the ground. - The girl between the one in front of the clue and a boy she's looking at. - The girl at the edge of the field. Walk in the directions that the scarecrows on the ground are pointing.

title: Puzzle Box
description: On a desk in the middle row. Solution (Story): - Cherry, Strawberry - Book x3 - Flower Solution (Hard): - Apple, Cherry, Orange, Grapes, Pineapple, Strawberry - Book x4 - Leafy Non-Potted Plant, Flowers x2 Solution (Lost in the Fog): - Orange, Apple, Cherry, Strawberry, Grapes, Pineapple - Book x5 - Non-Potted Flower x3, Leafy Non-Potted Plant

title: Shrine Vault Puzzle
description: The final Ema board you flip will reveal [Combination Lock Dial](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-f/maps/ebisugaoka?locationIds=483001). Solution (Story): - Find and flip the Ema boards showing a crane, serpent, and tortoise. Copy the symbols on their backsides into the lock - check the journal for a reminder of what they look like. Solution (Hard): - Find and flip the Ema boards showing lightning, a decayed tree, and kudzu (big white flowers). Copy the symbols on their backsides into the lock - check the journal for a reminder of what they look like. Solution (Lost in the Fog): - Find and flip the Ema boards showing the Yokai of the Carriage (wagon monster), 'Yokai of the Umbrella' (triangle monster), and Yokai of the Kettle (three-legged monster). Check the journal for a reminder of the symbols on the back, then copy the second Carriage symbol, fourth Umbrella symbol, and third Kettle symbol into the lock.

title: Cage Puzzle
description: Solution (Story): - Make both statue pairs look at their partners. Solution (Hard): - Make both statue pairs look away from their partners. Solution (Lost in the Fog): - Make the left pair look away from each other, and right pair look to the left.

title: Picture Puzzle
description: Can only be solved after finding the [Picture Frame](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-f/maps/ebisugaoka?locationIds=483668). Solution (All Difficulties / Endings): - Look at the main photograph; the faces that have been scratched out must have their respective portraits flipped upside-down. - The exact portraits will change based on the ending route you're on.

title: My Room
description: Can only be attempted after finding the [White Bird and Fox Plate](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-f/maps/ebisugaoka?locationIds=483697), [Scales Plate](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-f/maps/ebisugaoka?locationIds=483673), and [Black Bird and Sword Plate](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-f/maps/ebisugaoka?locationIds=483703). Solution (Ending 1 / NG): - Sword left, Heavens top, Scales rotated on bottom, Fox right Solution (Ending 2): - Scales left, Fox top, Heavens rotated on bottom, Black bird right Solution (Ending 3): - White bird left, Sword top, Heavens rotated on bottom, Scales right Solution (Ending 4): - White bird left, Scales rotated on top, Heavens on bottom, Black bird right

title: Scales Puzzle
description: Solution (Ending 1 / NG): - Headless doll on left scale, other 4 on right Solution (Ending 2): - Ending 2: Bowing and headless doll on left scale, other 3 on right Solution (Ending 3): - Hinako and headless doll on left scale, other 3 on right Solution (Ending 4): - Hinako on left side, other 4 on right

title: Hermitage of Crimson Water Puzzle
description: Solution (All Difficulties): - Ring the bells in this order: - [Stone Bell](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-f/maps/ebisugaoka?locationIds=483867) - [Water Bell](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-f/maps/ebisugaoka?locationIds=483865) - [Wood Bell](https://mapgenie.io/silent-hill-f/maps/ebisugaoka?locationIds=483866) After solving the puzzle once, it will automatically be completed on all future playthroughs.

title: Mural
description: Solution (Ending 1 / NG): - Fox Crest in leftmost fox's fan, Black Sparrow in back of a fox with X-shaped rope across his back, White Sparrow in the lantern he's pointing at. Solution (Ending 2): - Fox Crest in leftmost fox's fan, Black Sparrow in the lantern under the carriage, White Sparrow in the lantern above a hat-wearing fox sitting on the ground. Solution (Ending 3): - White Sparrow in lowest right lantern, Black Sparrow in the lantern closest to it, Fox Crest in the lantern above the carriage on the far left. Solution (Ending 4): - Black Sparrow inside the carriage, White Sparrow below the carriage, Fox Crest in the lantern above the carriage.
